cut.text: Kathang-isip: ang medalyon at ang boses nito, ang punyal, ang lambat at ang tatak.

keep_with_the_word.text: Kuwentong-bayan ang tikbalang at ang pagpapaamo rito, at diwata ng bundok Makiling si Mariang Makiling.
keep_with_the_word.why: Folklore attribution in a sentence of its own, so the tikbalang and Mariang Makiling do not pass as the record. Sentence 31 ('gaya ng sinasabi ng kuwentong-bayan') is plot that names the folklore, so it stays too.
